title: Going deeper: Feelings can stay; hitting stops
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Use the voice safety needs, then teach, reconnect and preserve dignity.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
practice: name the feeling and hold the physical boundary
principle: Acknowledge emotion without permitting unsafe behaviour.
nextSentence: Hitting or hurting still stops. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can name the feeling and hold the physical boundary.
keyLearning: Acknowledge emotion without permitting unsafe behaviour.
